source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
In your [Command phase](vsdata:core-rule/command-phase), this unit can roll 1 D6 as a **[psychic roll](vsdata:core-rule/psychic-abilities)** if it is not **battle-shocked**. If you roll:

- on a 1, the unit becomes **battle-shocked**
- until your next Command phase starts, the unit has the **[assault doctrine](vsdata:ability/space-marines.combat-doctrines)** active as well as any other **combat doctrine**

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
